roleContext.jobDescription: The message queue service carries the events between the company's product services, and when it slows everything slows. The Platform Engineer operates the queue clusters in production: deploys cluster changes to production, holds a place on the platform on-call rota and handles production incidents such as a partition leader storm or a consumer lag alert, watches live throughput and lag dashboards, runs the capacity changes with the product teams that own the busiest topics, and documents cluster boundaries. Reports to the head of platform infrastructure; works with the product service teams, the SRE group and the cloud provider's support team.

requirements.text: Has deployed queue cluster changes to production and watched live throughput and lag dashboards after each change.
Is on the platform on-call rota and has handled production incidents such as a partition leader storm or consumer lag.
Runs capacity changes with the owners of the busiest topics and records own responsibility boundaries.
Tests cluster changes on the staging clusters with a documented load profile before production deployment.
Documents cluster limitations and hand-over conditions for each change.

candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Platform Engineer, Message Queue Service

## Experience

- Deployed cluster changes to the three production message queue clusters over two and a half years, including two broker version upgrades and the move to tiered storage, each under a change record in my name.
- On the platform on-call rota throughout and handled the production incidents on my shifts, including the partition leader storm of July 2024 and four consumer lag incidents, all recorded in the platform incident log.
- Watched the live throughput and lag dashboards after each change and ran the capacity changes with the owning teams of the six busiest topics, recording in each change record which checks were mine and which were the topic owners'.
- Tested each cluster change on the staging clusters under the documented load profile before production deployment, with the staging results attached to the change record.
- Documented cluster limitations and the hand-over conditions for each change in the change record's closure section and in the platform runbook.

## Work samples

- Work sample: the change records for the two broker upgrades and the tiered storage move with their staging results, and the platform incident log records for the July 2024 leader storm and the four lag incidents.
